newsitem.title: CHINA: China Int'l Travel net up as more get travel bug.
newsitem.headline: China Int'l Travel net up as more get travel bug.

text.p: Shanghai China International Travel Service Co Ltd on Friday attributed a 10 percent rise in 1996 net profit to an increase in the number of people travelling both at home and abroad.

The company reaped net profits of 43.455 million yuan in 1996 under international accounting standards, up 10.25 percent from 39.416 million yuan in 1995, the company's 1996 annual report, published in Shanghai Securities News, said.
More than 600,000 people joined the company's organised group tours to China in 1996, up 6.3 percent from 1995, the report said, adding that domestic travellers became its new profit source.
Tours within China attracted 19,622 Chinese residents in 1996, up 126 percent on the previous year, and 2,987 went on the company's overseas tours, up 301 percent, the report said.
Profits in other fields also recorded solid increases last year, accounting for 40 percent of total profit, China Travel said but did not elaborate.
The company's other businesses include property, restaurants, advertising, transport and information services, the annual report said.
